title: Midnight Sunwatch
text:
🌙 Midnight Sunwatch — September 20, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B3.9)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B5.1 (Peaked September 20, 2026 at 03:35 UTC)
🔥 Strongest recent flare: C3.3 (Peaked September 19, 2026 at 18:17 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 391 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 2.33)
🚨 NOAA Warning: Geomagnetic K-index of 4 expected

Just a little flare! 🔥

A large coronal hole is prominent on the Sun today, alongside bright structured activity near the left limb.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 195 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
